limits.basis: estimates: scale-out from 0 = alarm 60 s + SQS metric delay + Fargate start (infra 5a timeline); poison limit = allowance + (maxReceiveCount + 1) release cycles (release-at-once rule, decision 7.2) + DLQ count lag; WITHOUT release-at-once the poison needs maxReceiveCount x visibility timeout and is reported not seen within this limit; each part 2 wait limit counts from the start of that wait (after part 1 for the first), and the worker log is read at least once per wait (J-01)

selection.source: DynamoDB ArtifactRegistry (M-01: the vector bucket policy denies the S3 Vectors data plane to this principal)
selection.rule: the first unique pk artifact#vector#INDEX/KEY in scan order (bounded read-only scan, begins_with(pk), projection pk), then the latest version (Query ScanIndexForward=false Limit 1)
selection.checked: textHash, embeddingModel, embeddingDimensions present in the latest registry version; embeddingModel equal to expected_embedding_model (the document-side EmbeddingModelSpec.id built from config/course.json embedding.provider, models.embeddingModelId, embedding.dimensions and the rag spec version, L-02) and embeddingDimensions equal to config/course.json; the vector metadata itself is checked by the handler (permanent failure on a missing field)

observation.part1_poison: seen: DLQ count baseline + 1 and the poison taskId read back from the DLQ (never deleted)
observation.part2_replay: seen: worker log 'processed', then after the second send 'replayed'
observation.part3_api: statuses first=200/absent replay=200/true conflict=409/absent (expected: first 200, replay 200 with Idempotent-Replayed true, conflict 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT)
observation.recovery: embedding in flight back to 0: yes; DLQ alarm ALARM: yes; valid task processed while the poison was retried: yes (sent right after the poison)
